criteria.text: Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies that 15% of 24,000,000 Firm Shares is 3,600,000 shares, not the 4,800,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 11 June 2027 is 9 days before the 20 June 2027 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies the inconsistency between 61,750,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 63,000,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.
Lists securities-law exemptions/registrations required for each offering jurisdiction and states they are not addressed.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 24,000,000 = 3,600,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
